rules: Historical migration filenames are immutable and must not be renamed after deployment.
Intent and historical naming clarifications must be recorded in this manifest.
Validation must fail if a SQL migration file exists without a manifest entry, or vice versa.

migrations.intent: Create foundational runs and audit_events tables.
Add run lifecycle status/timestamp columns and status constraint.
Add backtest/replay schema including md_bars and run_events.
Add md_quality_reports ingest quality table and index.
Add outbox claim tracking columns for dispatcher claim-lock semantics.
Add singleton sys_arm_state table for fail-closed persisted arm state.
Add broker_order_map persistence for crash-safe cancel/replace recovery.
Add reconcile checkpoint watermark persistence.
Add/strengthen DB constraints enforcing allowed state values and relationships.
Add idempotency constraints for outbox/inbox safety.
Add inbox applied tracking column(s) for atomic apply semantics.
Remove implicit default from reconcile checkpoint timestamp field(s).
Add/repair FK relationship between broker mapping and outbox rows.
Add consistency checks around outbox claim metadata/state transitions.
Scope inbox dedupe uniqueness to run identity.
Add explicit DISPATCHING outbox state support.
Expand arm-state disarm reasons to include recovery quarantine semantics.
Held alternative migration for global broker_fill_id uniqueness; not part of deployed chain.
Create runtime_leader_lease, runtime_control_state, and runtime_restart_requests tables.
migrations.filename_note: Filename mentions outbox dispatching, but deployed content establishes runtime leader/control/restart tables. Name is preserved for migration-history safety.

migrations.intent: Add durable broker_event_cursor table for restart-safe event consumption.
Add explicit AMBIGUOUS outbox status and supporting constraints.
Add explicit broker identity/lineage columns on inbox rows.
Add durable operator truth tables for risk block and reconcile status.
Extend sys_arm_state.reason constraints to include operator/runtime lease and deadman disarm reasons already used by durable control surfaces.
Add unique economic fill dedupe on (run_id, broker_fill_id) while preserving transport-message dedupe.
Add missing enriched inbox identity columns used by current insert contract and backfill defaults for existing rows.
Add durable risk_denial_events table for persisted risk denial event history.
Add durable sys_strategy_suppressions table for restart-safe strategy suppression persistence (CC-02).
Add fill_quality_telemetry table for durable, per-fill execution quality telemetry (TV-EXEC-01): actual price, timing, slippage, and provenance per fill event.
Add sys_strategy_registry table as the authoritative durable registry of known strategies (CC-01A): canonical identity, display name, enabled state, kind, and timestamps.
Expand runs.mode CHECK constraint to include 'live-shadow' alongside 'PAPER', 'LIVE', 'BACKTEST'.
Add sys_restart_intent multi-row log table for durable restart intent / restart provenance (CC-03B): mode transition verdict, initiated_by, lifecycle status, caller-injected timestamps.

Add sys_autonomous_session_events table for durable autonomous paper supervisor history/evidence (AUTON-PAPER-02): restart-safe recovery attempts/results, refusals, stop outcomes, and operator-reviewable soak evidence.
Add durable alert acknowledgment persistence for operator-facing alert triage truth.
Add durable incidents table and linkage support for operator incident tracking truth.
Add durable OMS order lifecycle event history for authoritative cancel/replace/fill/reject lineage.
Extend sys_arm_state.reason constraint to include InboundContinuityUnproven, enabling durable halt/disarm when Alpaca WS inbound continuity is cold-start unproven or gap-detected (EXEC-CONT-01).
Extend sys_arm_state.reason constraint to include CancelTargetMissing, enabling durable halt/disarm when a cancel outbox row targets an order absent from the live OMS map (EXEC-CANCEL-01).

Add dispatch_attempt_count, next_dispatch_after_utc, last_dispatch_error to oms_outbox for bounded, backoff-gated, restart-safe retryable dispatch (EXEC-RETRY-01). Claim filter gates on next_dispatch_after_utc so backed-off rows are invisible to the dispatcher until their window expires.

Add sys_broker_position_baseline singleton table for durable operator-adopted broker position baseline at paper startup (sentinel_id=1 pattern matching sys_arm_state). No DEFAULT now() or DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() — callers supply all fields.

MIGRATION-0040-BACKFILL-DUP-FILLS-01: deterministic historical cleanup of duplicate event_kind='fill' rows (WS+REST dual delivery, Pattern A applied; REST reingestion, Pattern B unapplied) followed by unique partial index uq_inbox_run_order_single_fill enforcing at most one final fill per (run_id, internal_order_id). Canonical keep rule: applied over unapplied, broker_fill_id present over null, earliest applied_at_utc, earliest received_at_utc, lowest inbox_id.

DATA-INGEST-JOB-PERSISTENCE-01: add sys_ingest_jobs durable daemon ingest job history for DB-backed job list/status restart survival. Caller supplies all timestamps; no provider secrets or raw provider payloads are stored.

DATA-PROVIDER-MD-SOURCE-METADATA-01: add provider/source provenance metadata to canonical md_bars without changing the existing (symbol, timeframe, end_ts) primary key. Existing rows backfill provider_id='unknown'.

AUTON-NO-SIGNAL-OBS-01: add strategy_signal_evaluations durable journal table so a market-hours autonomous run that evaluates real bars but produces no order leaves durable evidence after daemon restart. Nullable run_id, no FK; observability only, not part of the outbox/inbox/run lifecycle chain.

AUTON-NO-TRADE-OFFHOURS-01B: add autonomous_no_trade_diagnostics durable snapshot table so the GET /api/v1/autonomous/readiness verdict (session window, arm/runtime-start state, overall_ready, dominant reason) survives a daemon restart instead of existing only as an in-memory/live-DB-read computation. Deterministic minute-bucketed UUIDv5 id bounds duplicate rows from frequent polling. Nullable run_id, no FK; observability only, not part of the outbox/inbox/run lifecycle chain. paper_order_attempted and live_order_attempted are always false.

PAPER-DAILY-PNL-BASELINE-01-COMBINED: add sys_account_equity_baseline table storing a provenance-tagged account-equity snapshot per trading_date (primary key), so GET /api/v1/portfolio/summary.daily_pnl can compare current equity against a real previous-session-close baseline instead of always returning null. No DEFAULT now() or DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() — callers supply captured_at_utc and audit_event_id. No automatic capture mechanism is added by this migration or this patch group's Phase B/C — capture is explicitly deferred to a future patch.

STRATEGY-PROMOTION-REGISTRY-01B: add sys_strategy_promotion_transitions durable, append-only strategy paper-promotion registry (strategy_id + symbol + timeframe_secs identity; states shadow_approved/paper_approved/active_paper/demoted/retired/rejected; CHECK-constrained legal transition graph; evidence provenance columns; caller-injected transition_id/timestamps, no DEFAULT now() or DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()). No mutable current-state row — current state is always a deterministic query over history. No backfill from sys_strategy_registry.enabled; table is empty after migration, meaning zero approved strategies.

STRATEGY-PROMOTION-REGISTRY-CLOSURE-REPAIR-01: add nullable parent_transition_id (self-referential FK) and evidence_transition_id (self-referential FK) columns to sys_strategy_promotion_transitions. parent_transition_id supports transactional concurrency serialization (mqk_db::insert_strategy_promotion_transition_serialized: pg_advisory_xact_lock keyed on identity, re-read-then-compare inside one transaction, stable transition_conflict rejection on a stale parent) so two concurrent transitions can never both be accepted as children of the same parent. evidence_transition_id supports durable evidence-lineage resolution (mqk_db::resolve_evidence_lineage) so any current state derived from a non-evidence-bearing transition (e.g. active_paper reached via paper_approved) can still be traced back to the exact evidence-bearing transition that authorized it. Both columns nullable (schema-safety only, no backfill decision required); the daemon route always populates both going forward. No existing column, row, or constraint altered.

AUTONOMOUS-DAILY-PAPER-OPERATIONS-01B-DURABLE-COORDINATION: add sys_autonomous_daily_operations (mutable current-state row, one per (market_date, deployment_mode, adapter_id) daily slot, CAS via state_version) and sys_autonomous_daily_operation_events (append-only transition history keyed (operation_id, transition_seq)). operation_id (UUIDv5 over six identity components, derived in mqk-daemon) is the primary key; the daily slot is a separate unique constraint, so a same-day identity mismatch is a typed conflict, never a second row or a silently rewritten identity field. No DEFAULT now()/gen_random_uuid()/fabricated numeric default on any not-null column -- every initial value (including state_version=1, start_attempt_count=0, bars_observed=0, bars_dispatched=0) is caller-supplied. Foundation only: no wiring into session_controller.rs, autonomous_bar_ticker.rs, the market-data scheduler, start_execution_runtime, any HTTP route, or any GUI component.

AUTONOMOUS-DAILY-PAPER-OPERATIONS-01B-BOUNDARY-MODEL-REPAIR-01: separate exchange-schedule truth from effective-autonomous-operation-window truth on sys_autonomous_daily_operations. Does not modify 0048. The pre-existing session_open_utc/session_close_utc columns remain physically present and are now explicitly documented (via COMMENT ON COLUMN) as the effective operation boundaries (mapped in Rust as effective_operation_open_utc/effective_operation_close_utc), never conflated with exchange truth. Adds nullable exchange_session_open_utc, exchange_session_close_utc, exchange_is_early_close, previous_trading_date columns carrying authoritative exchange-calendar facts, with a CHECK requiring all four present together or all four null (legacy-row compatibility only, no backfill), an exchange open-before-close CHECK, and a previous-trading-date-before-market-date CHECK. Every new row created through the current mqk_db::autonomous_daily_operation store API supplies all four exchange fields as non-null.

AUTONOMOUS-DAILY-PAPER-OPERATIONS-01C-COMPLETED-BAR-DATA-DRIVER: add sys_autonomous_daily_bar_dispatches durable bar-identity-keyed dispatch claim table, additive, does not modify 0048/0049. Audit found no existing durable idempotency keyed on bar identity (symbol, timeframe, end_ts) anywhere in the native strategy dispatch/outbox path -- strategy_signal_evaluations dedupes on an arbitrary tick counter and oms_outbox dedupes on wall-clock now_micros, neither of which prevents re-dispatch of the same completed bar across a restart or retry. Primary key (operation_id, local_symbol, timeframe, bar_end_ts); status in ('claimed','completed','uncertain','failed'); foreign key to sys_autonomous_daily_operations with no destructive cascade (default NO ACTION). No DEFAULT now()/gen_random_uuid()/fabricated default on any not-null column -- every value including claimed_at_utc is caller-supplied.

AUTONOMOUS-DAILY-PAPER-OPERATIONS-01D2-DURABLE-SESSION-COORDINATOR: add nullable stop_attempt_count/last_stop_attempt_utc columns to sys_autonomous_daily_operations, additive, does not modify 0048/0049/0050. Closes the durable stop-retry evidence gap: the existing schema had durable start-attempt evidence but nothing equivalent for the canonical stop_execution_runtime path. Legacy rows round-trip both columns as null (unknown history, never fabricated as zero); every row created through the current mqk_db::autonomous_daily_operation store API supplies an explicit stop_attempt_count of 0 at insert time -- no SQL DEFAULT.

AUTONOMOUS-DAILY-PAPER-OPERATIONS-01D2-LIFECYCLE-CLOSURE-REPAIR-01: add nullable state_blocker_signature column to sys_autonomous_daily_operations, additive, does not modify 0048/0049/0050/0051. Closes a dedup-authority gap: state_reason_code alone cannot distinguish two distinct blocker occurrences sharing the same reason code. state_blocker_signature carries the D1 typed bounded blocker signature (sha256:<64 hex chars>) so dedup requires (state, state_reason_code, state_blocker_signature) together. Legacy rows round-trip as null (never fabricated); every new row created through the current mqk_db::autonomous_daily_operation store API supplies an explicit null at insert time -- no SQL DEFAULT.

DURABLE-PAPER-PORTFOLIO-AND-PNL-01B-DURABLE-STORE: add sys_paper_portfolio_snapshots (append-only, deterministically-identified durable copy of an accepted authoritative broker account/position snapshot; source distinguishes 'external_alpaca' real truth from 'synthetic_diagnostic', never authoritative), sys_paper_portfolio_snapshot_positions (child rows, PK (snapshot_id, symbol)), and sys_paper_portfolio_accounting_state (one row per run_id, caching a replay of that run's already-durable oms_inbox applied fills through mqk-portfolio's FIFO engine -- not a second fill ledger; no fill content is duplicated, only the computed cash/realized-P&L/fees summary and the last_applied_inbox_id watermark that makes re-application idempotent). Additive only, does not modify any existing table. No DEFAULT now()/gen_random_uuid() -- every timestamp and identity is caller-supplied.

DURABLE-PAPER-PORTFOLIO-AND-PNL-01-FINAL-RUN-SCOPING-ACCOUNTING-AND-CLOSURE-REPAIR: add nullable source_snapshot_id (self-referencing FK to sys_paper_portfolio_snapshots.snapshot_id) to sys_paper_portfolio_accounting_state, additive, does not modify 0053. Ties a durable accounting row to the exact broker snapshot whose positions were used to compute its accounting_epoch/accounting_epoch_reason, closing the cross-run/cross-snapshot provenance gap found in the Bundle 4 final closure review. Legacy rows round-trip source_snapshot_id as null (never backfilled/fabricated); a null value means completeness cannot be traced to a specific snapshot and must not be reported as fully proven active truth.

RUNTIME-OPPORTUNITY-ALLOCATION-01 Phase G: add sys_runtime_opportunity_allocation_plans (one durable row per allocation cycle, plan_id = the deterministic cycle_id, written only in shadow/paper_enforced mode -- the default off mode never writes here) and sys_runtime_opportunity_allocation_candidates (child rows, one per new/increasing-buy candidate considered; sell/reduce/exit/flatten decisions never appear here). Allocation evidence only -- never portfolio/P&L/order truth; equity_micros/source_snapshot_id are copied from the already-durable sys_paper_portfolio_snapshots row the cycle read, not a second NAV source. Scores/weights stored as scaled integers (x1,000,000), no binary float column. Additive only, does not modify any existing table. No DEFAULT now()/gen_random_uuid() -- every timestamp and identity is caller-supplied.

MULTI-STRATEGY-CONFLICT-POLICY-01 Phase C: add sys_runtime_strategy_conflict_plans (one durable row per conflict-policy cycle, plan_id = the deterministic cycle_id, written only in shadow/paper_enforced mode -- the default off mode never writes here) and sys_runtime_strategy_conflict_candidates (child rows, one per candidate considered across every symbol group in the cycle, both buy and sell sides). Conflict-resolution evidence only -- never portfolio/P&L/order truth; records which exact original candidate (if any) was selected per symbol and why, never a rebuilt decision. Additive only, does not modify any existing table. No DEFAULT now()/gen_random_uuid() -- every timestamp and identity is caller-supplied.

MULTI-STRATEGY-CONFLICT-POLICY-01-AUTHORITY-AND-EVIDENCE-REPAIR Defect 5: add nullable configured_mode to sys_runtime_strategy_conflict_plans (requested mode before the paper+Alpaca live-lock; mode remains the already-resolved effective mode) plus a plan_id=cycle_id consistency CHECK, and nullable order_type/time_in_force/limit_price/bar_present/bar_symbol/bar_strategy_id/bar_timeframe/close_micros to sys_runtime_strategy_conflict_candidates (full candidate bar provenance and order semantics, closing the 0056 gap where sell candidates carried no bar facts at all). Additive only, does not modify 0056. No backfill -- every 0056-era row round-trips the new columns as NULL and must be read as legacy/incomplete evidence, never fabricated or projected as active current truth.

DYNAMIC-STRATEGY-SYMBOL-SELECTION-01-FOUNDATION-AUTHORITY-CLOSURE-02 Defect B: add nullable evidence_fingerprint_v2 to sys_strategy_promotion_transitions, additive, does not modify 0046/0047. The legacy evidence_fingerprint hashes the matched review row after scanner_score has already been deserialized to f64, so two distinct raw decimal tokens can collide to the same legacy fingerprint while producing different exact Bundle 7 rankings. evidence_fingerprint_v2 is a versioned SHA-256 computed directly from the exact raw score token plus every other matched-row field affecting evidence identity. Legacy rows round-trip this column as NULL -- never backfilled from the mutable review-artifact filesystem at read time; Bundle 7's read-side validator refuses any identity lacking a v2 fingerprint with a distinct durable_fingerprint_v2_missing reason.
